title: EU VISUAL
headline: Visual systems for European hospitality and retail.
description: Selected concept projects built across social design, campaign thinking and art direction.

projects.title: North Pier Coffee & Bakehouse
projects.subtitle: Coffee & Bakehouse
projects.category: Hospitality / Social Art Direction / Visual System

cover.alt: North Pier coffee and croissant beside a Rotterdam waterfront window

overview.summary: North Pier Coffee & Bakehouse is a fictional Rotterdam waterfront café concept developed to explore how a hospitality brand can stay visually consistent while moving across product, lifestyle, seasonal and service-led social content.
overview.objective: The system combines a defined brand world, repeatable visual rules and varied social layouts without relying on one repeated template.
overview.positioning: A design-conscious neighbourhood destination, built around two daily rituals: fresh baking and really good coffee.
overview.brandIdea: Made for slow mornings and busy days.

typography.name: Instrument Sans
typography.description: Architectural clarity and utility. Clean contemporary structure for headlines and functional information.

typography.name: Newsreader
typography.description: Warmth and an editorial food-and-hospitality character. Product titles and selected quiet moments.

brand.visualTerritory: Rotterdam industrial clarity × bakery warmth × waterfront calm.
brand.photographyDirection: Soft Northern-European daylight. Warm food against cooler surroundings. Calm architecture, natural depth and a 35–50mm editorial lens feeling.

placeSheet.alt: North Pier approved place reference sheet

productsSheet.alt: North Pier approved product reference sheet

socialDesigns.alt: North Pier — Brand Introduction
socialDesigns.title: Brand Introduction
socialDesigns.purpose: Introduce North Pier and establish the core visual identity immediately.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: A calm waterfront product scene combines bakery warmth with Rotterdam’s cooler architectural character, using large brand typography and controlled negative space.

socialDesigns.alt: North Pier — Bakery Spotlight
socialDesigns.title: Bakery Spotlight
socialDesigns.purpose: Introduce a repeatable bakery storytelling format and make the Cinnamon Bun a clear product hero.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: A structured editorial panel separates product storytelling from photography and begins a numbered Bakery content series.

socialDesigns.alt: North Pier — Coffee Ritual
socialDesigns.title: Coffee Ritual
socialDesigns.purpose: Shift from static product imagery into craft, motion and preparation.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: The coffee pour becomes the hero action, supported by open typography and a more dynamic composition while remaining inside the same North Pier world.

socialDesigns.alt: North Pier — People / Lifestyle
socialDesigns.title: People / Lifestyle
socialDesigns.purpose: Position North Pier as a place to work, pause and spend time, rather than only a product destination.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: A quiet human moment by the window shifts attention from the menu to the experience of being inside the café.

socialDesigns.alt: North Pier — Seasonal Campaign
socialDesigns.title: Seasonal Campaign
socialDesigns.purpose: Demonstrate how the visual system can support timely seasonal communication without abandoning the core identity.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: A close seasonal pastry hero and larger campaign-style typography create a stronger promotional moment while preserving the established palette and photography language.

socialDesigns.alt: North Pier — From the Counter
socialDesigns.title: From the Counter
socialDesigns.purpose: Introduce clear menu-style communication and demonstrate commercial flexibility.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: A front-facing counter lineup breaks the previous hero-image rhythm. Products are aligned as a structured selection with labels and concise supporting information.

socialDesigns.alt: North Pier — Service Moment
socialDesigns.title: Service Moment
socialDesigns.purpose: Add hospitality, takeaway service and human interaction to the visual system.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: A behind-the-counter handoff focuses on the interaction between barista, customer and branded takeaway cup, expanding the brand beyond product photography.

socialDesigns.alt: North Pier — By the Water
socialDesigns.title: By the Water
socialDesigns.purpose: Anchor the entire project in place and close the social sequence with North Pier as a physical destination.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: An exterior waterfront perspective shifts away from food and service to architecture, atmosphere and Rotterdam location.

aiProcess.title: Visual Production System
aiProcess.copy: The campaign scenes were developed through an AI-assisted visual production workflow built around locked place and product references. Rather than generating unrelated imagery for each post, the process used a consistent environment, product language and art-direction system to maintain continuity across the campaign.

closing.statement: A social identity built around coffee, fresh baking and life by the water.

image.alt: North Pier exterior overlooking the Rotterdam waterfront

sections.title: A neighbourhood ritual. A complete visual world.
Coffee, bread and life by the water.
sections.copy: A contemporary Rotterdam coffee & bakehouse designed around everyday rituals: fresh baking, considered coffee and a calm place to stay.

sections.title: One place. Every scene.
sections.copy: A fixed environment system was created before producing the social campaign, keeping architecture, materials, lighting and furniture consistent across scenes.

sections.title: A familiar cast.
sections.copy: A product reference system was developed to keep pastries, coffee, ceramics and tableware visually consistent across the campaign.

sections.title: One visual world. Multiple content roles.
sections.copy: The layout and perspective change. The identity stays recognisable.

sections.title: A system designed to stay consistent without repeating itself.

cover.alt: TRAMA Rigatoni Burrata and Tomato social design — Sauce Does the Talking

overview.summary: TRAMA is a fictional fresh pasta bar concept created for Berlin's younger food audience. The project explores a bold social-first visual system built around fresh pasta, appetite-led imagery, playful typography and fast-moving campaign content.
overview.functionalLine: Fresh pasta. Fast content. Strong appetite.

typography.name: Bebas Neue
typography.description: Condensed display type gives the food-led headlines a direct, graphic voice.

typography.name: Poppins
typography.description: Rounded geometric type handles dish names and the smaller lines inside the approved artwork.

socialDesigns.alt: TRAMA Four Moods TWIRL — Spaghetti Pomodoro social media design
socialDesigns.title: TWIRL — Spaghetti Pomodoro
socialDesigns.purpose: A burgundy field and a tightly wound forkful introduce the campaign's bold Italian mood.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: Repeated Pomodoro type sits behind the fork; the headline stays clear above it.

socialDesigns.alt: TRAMA Four Moods ZESTY — Lemon Butter Pasta social media design
socialDesigns.title: ZESTY — Lemon Butter Pasta
socialDesigns.purpose: Express a brighter, buttery personality inside the same campaign structure.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: Warm cream replaces burgundy while lemon zest and pale pasta hold the centre.

socialDesigns.alt: TRAMA Four Moods FRESH — Pesto Pasta social media design
socialDesigns.title: FRESH — Pesto Pasta
socialDesigns.purpose: Give pesto its own green personality without changing the campaign's visual grammar.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: Basil, pesto and a green field share the same vertical fork composition.

socialDesigns.alt: TRAMA Four Moods FEISTY — Spicy Arrabbiata social media design
socialDesigns.title: FEISTY — Spicy Arrabbiata
socialDesigns.purpose: Close the four-part sequence with a hotter, more assertive mood.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: Orange surrounds stacked rigatoni; chilli and sauce reinforce the headline's attitude.

socialDesigns.alt: TRAMA Rigatoni Burrata & Tomato — SAUCE DOES THE TALKING social campaign design
socialDesigns.title: Rigatoni Burrata & Tomato
socialDesigns.purpose: Let the sauce and burrata lead the campaign opening.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: Burgundy curves frame a large plate; the cream area gives the headline its own space.

socialDesigns.alt: TRAMA Cacio e Pepe — PEPPER IN MOTION social campaign design
socialDesigns.title: Cacio e Pepe
socialDesigns.purpose: Turn seasoning into the focal moment of a food post.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: Falling pepper connects the hand above to the pasta below, between two clear text areas.

socialDesigns.alt: TRAMA Beef Ragù — SLOW COOKED BIG MOOD social campaign design
socialDesigns.title: Beef Ragù
socialDesigns.purpose: Make the fork lift carry the dish's rich, slow-cooked character.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: Lifted ribbons sit opposite three stacked headline lines on a burgundy panel.

socialDesigns.alt: TRAMA From Kitchen to Table — FROM KITCHEN TO TABLE social campaign design
socialDesigns.title: From Kitchen to Table
socialDesigns.purpose: Expand the story from a plate to the experience of being served.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: A foreground handoff leads back to the open kitchen, with type placed in the lighter window area.

socialDesigns.alt: TRAMA Penne Pomodoro social campaign design
socialDesigns.title: Penne Pomodoro
socialDesigns.purpose: Give the feed a clear graphic pause between action-led scenes.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: Oversized Penne Pasta lettering crosses behind the plate; outlined letters keep the overlap readable.

socialDesigns.alt: TRAMA Fresh Focaccia — TEAR IT UP — FRESH FOCACCIA social campaign design
socialDesigns.title: Fresh Focaccia
socialDesigns.purpose: Make the bread's crust and soft interior the subject.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: Two hands pull the focaccia apart diagonally, exposing the crumb below the headline.

projects.title: CASA LUME
projects.subtitle: Boutique Hotel — Porto
projects.category: Boutique Hospitality / Social Content / Campaign System

cover.alt: CASA LUME Boutique Hotel Porto project cover at night

overview.summary: CASA LUME is a fictional boutique hotel concept in Porto built around a quieter kind of city stay.
overview.objective: The project explores how art direction, campaign thinking, AI-generated hospitality imagery and short-form content can turn a beautiful property into a repeatable social content system.
overview.positioning: Campaign Content Direction and Monthly Content Systems for Boutique Hospitality Brands.
overview.functionalLine: ART DIRECTION · SOCIAL CONTENT · AI VISUALS · SHORT-FORM
overview.challenge:
Boutique hotel content often stops at room photography.

CASA LUME explores how light, rituals, weather, neighbourhood and the rhythm of returning to the hotel can turn one property into a repeatable social content system.

typography.name: Cormorant Garamond
typography.description: An editorial serif for campaign statements and the quieter, more expressive side of the hotel world.
typography.sample: A quieter kind of city stay.

typography.name: Manrope
typography.description: A restrained sans serif for project information, campaign structure and practical communication.

brand.visualTerritory: Quiet European hospitality shaped through architecture, local rituals and seasonal atmosphere.
brand.photographyDirection: Warm natural light, tactile interiors, local Porto views and softer weather moments connect the property to the rhythm of the city.

socialDesigns.alt: CASA LUME Weekend Escape social design — 48 Hours, Made to Feel Longer
socialDesigns.title: Weekend Escape
socialDesigns.purpose: Open the short-stay campaign with a clear booking idea.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: A light editorial panel sits over the sunlit room while the property remains the visual lead.

socialDesigns.alt: CASA LUME Porto Just Outside social design
socialDesigns.title: Porto, Just Outside
socialDesigns.purpose: Connect the hotel stay to the surrounding Porto streets.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: A doorway frames the city before the editorial message closes the composition.

socialDesigns.alt: CASA LUME Check In Slow Down social design
socialDesigns.title: Check In. Slow Down.
socialDesigns.purpose: Turn the arrival ritual into a quiet hospitality moment.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: A brass room key and warm reception light make the handover the entire story.

socialDesigns.alt: CASA LUME The Stay social design — Made for Slower Hours
socialDesigns.title: The Stay
socialDesigns.purpose: Position the room as a slower, tactile retreat.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: Dark umber framing gives the soft room light and brass detail a quieter editorial weight.

socialDesigns.alt: CASA LUME Porto Outside social design — A City Worth Wandering
socialDesigns.title: Porto Outside
socialDesigns.purpose: Extend the stay into neighbourhood detail and local exploration.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: Three Porto moments share one restrained editorial page rather than competing as separate travel images.

socialDesigns.alt: CASA LUME Seasonal Stay social design — Porto in a Softer Season
socialDesigns.title: Seasonal Stay
socialDesigns.purpose: Make quieter travel periods feel intentional and desirable.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: The open balcony and soft room foreground hold the booking message inside the stay itself.

socialDesigns.alt: CASA LUME Small Rituals social design — The Morning Starts Softer
socialDesigns.title: Small Rituals
socialDesigns.purpose: Show how small details make the property feel lived-in.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: Overlapping coffee, book and key details create a tactile morning sequence.

socialDesigns.alt: CASA LUME Seasonal Booking social design — Make Porto Your Next Weekend
socialDesigns.title: Seasonal Booking
socialDesigns.purpose: Close the sequence with a direct seasonal booking message.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: Dark umber, aged brass and the room view create a decisive final campaign frame.

projects.title: FORMA
projects.subtitle: Gelato Bar — Vienna

cover.alt: FORMA Gelato Bar Vienna campaign cover — Flavour takes shape

overview.summary: FORMA is a self-initiated social campaign study for a contemporary gelato bar in Vienna. Built around the idea “Flavour takes shape,” the visual system translates flavour into bold colour, modular form and playful motion.
overview.objective: A compact graphic-led campaign designed to show how one visual system can move consistently across static social design, typography and short-form motion.
overview.functionalLine: GRAPHIC DESIGN · TYPOGRAPHY · SOCIAL CAMPAIGN · MOTION
overview.challenge: Each flavour becomes a distinct combination of colour, shape and movement, creating variety without losing campaign consistency.

typography.name: FROGIE
typography.description: The expressive display face gives every flavour a distinct, playful graphic voice.

typography.name: Inter Tight
typography.description: A compact sans serif keeps campaign information direct and consistent across formats.

brand.visualTerritory: Flavour translated into colour, shape, type and movement.
brand.photographyDirection: Product imagery stays direct and tactile while colour and graphic form give each flavour its own recognisable campaign expression.

socialDesigns.alt: FORMA Flavour Takes Shape social campaign design
socialDesigns.title: Flavour Takes Shape
socialDesigns.purpose: Introduce the campaign idea through the relationship between product, colour and shape.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: A pistachio cone cuts across modular red, green and yellow forms while display typography carries the campaign line.

socialDesigns.alt: FORMA Berry Bold strawberry gelato social design
socialDesigns.title: Berry Bold
socialDesigns.purpose: Give strawberry a clear campaign personality using one dominant graphic form.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: The flavour becomes a bold typographic strawberry built from the campaign’s red and cream palette.

socialDesigns.alt: FORMA Pistachio gelato social design
socialDesigns.title: Pistachio
socialDesigns.purpose: Build recognition through a flavour-specific colour and typographic composition.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: Oversized display lettering, pistachio green and a direct product crop create a single decisive flavour world.

socialDesigns.alt: FORMA Zest Mode lemon gelato social design
socialDesigns.title: Zest Mode
socialDesigns.purpose: Turn lemon flavour into a bright, energetic campaign moment.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: A yellow field, angular burst and tilted label give the lemon cone a sharper graphic rhythm.

socialDesigns.alt: FORMA Chocolate Please gelato social design
socialDesigns.title: Chocolate Please
socialDesigns.purpose: Give the chocolate flavour a rich but direct typographic treatment.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: Chocolate brown fills the frame while a top-down gelato bowl interrupts a loose modular grid.

socialDesigns.alt: FORMA What's Your Flavour social campaign design
socialDesigns.title: What’s Your Flavour?
socialDesigns.purpose: Bring the four flavour worlds together in one campaign question.
socialDesigns.visualApproach: Four product crops frame an oversized central question, turning the complete range into one graphic composition.

motionStories.title: MOTION 01
motionStories.subtitle: A supporting motion study extending the campaign’s typography, colour and modular shapes into vertical movement.

motionStories.title: MOTION 02 — FEATURED
motionStories.subtitle: The primary motion piece turns flavour, colour and shape into a playful sequence with a clear typographic rhythm.
motionStories.alt: FORMA featured Motion 02 vertical campaign film

motionStories.title: LIFESTYLE FILM
motionStories.subtitle: A lifestyle-led film connects the graphic campaign language back to the everyday gelato experience.
motionStories.alt: FORMA lifestyle vertical gelato campaign film

contentPillars: FLAVOUR|Each flavour receives its own colour and visual character.
SHAPE|Modular forms turn product qualities into a flexible graphic language.
TYPE|FROGIE creates the expressive voice while Inter Tight keeps information precise.
MOTION|Short-form movement carries the same system into vertical campaign content.

closing.statement: One campaign system. Six static designs. Three moving expressions. Flavour stays recognisable as it changes shape.
